career_ladder.note: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA) is the statutory regulator for the Indian pension sector, structured on the financial regulators' cadre hierarchy (parallel to SEBI and RBI) with progression from Grade A to executive and statutory board appointments.

steps.source_label: PFRDA (Salary and Allowances) Regulations and Grade A Recruitment Notification

steps.pay_level: Statutory Apex Scale (Appointments Committee of the Cabinet)
steps.source_label: PFRDA Act, 2013 and Ministry of Finance Rules

exam_scheme.note: Selection process for PFRDA Grade 'A' Assistant Managers consists of Phase I (Online Screening Test), Phase II (Online Test with Descriptive English and Professional Knowledge), and Phase III (Personal Interview).

stages.source_label: PFRDA Grade A Official Recruitment Notification

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: GA (Financial Sector), English, Quantitative Aptitude & Reasoning
Paper 2: Commerce, Accountancy, Finance, Management, Costing, Companies Act, Economics & Pension Sector

stages.source_label: PFRDA Grade A Official Recruitment Notification

papers.paper_name: Paper 1: English (Descriptive Test - Essay, Precis & Comprehension)
Paper 2: Specialized Professional Knowledge (Commerce, Finance, Economics & Pension Sector)

stages.source_label: PFRDA Grade A Official Recruitment Notification

papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit: Phase II (85% weightage) + Interview (15% weightage)

financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹62,500 in the scale ₹62,500 - 3,600(4) - 76,900 - 4,050(7) - 1,05,250 - EB - 4,050(4) - 1,21,450 - 4,650(1) - 1,26,100 (17 years). Total gross emoluments at New Delhi reach approx. ₹2,05,000 per month inclusive of DA (58% review baseline), Grade Allowance, Special Allowance, Housing Allowance / leased accommodation, Learning Allowance, and employer contribution to National Pension System.
official_perks: Authority Leased Residential Accommodation or Housing Allowance
Medical Expenses reimbursement for self and dependent family (hospitalization and OPD coverage)
Leave Fare Concession (LFC) biennial block entitlement
Education Allowance and Knowledge Updation Allowance
Monthly Conveyance Expense Reimbursement and Staff Furnishing Scheme
Computer / Laptop / Mobile Handset purchase scheme and monthly telephone reimbursement
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: Competition benchmarks reflect statutory regulatory recruitment by PFRDA at its New Delhi headquarters.
